sparse_rule: Use only calibration UID/target/count and fixed fold metadata. In each target merge the leftmost group with fewer than32 distinct training UIDs in any fold into its next higher neighbor; the last group merges lower. Repeat. Never merge targets. One shared map across folds and final fit; no residual-dependent grouping.
fold_rule: Sort calibration UIDs, permute once, assign position modulo5. All versions/snapshots of a UID share one fold.
fit: Per group minimize weighted squared panel maximum absolute logit residual with b>=0 and a>=0. Use original UID/target/state weights. Internally scale u by training-group weighted RMS for numerical conditioning, then convert a back to raw u. No regularizer or model selection.
matched_control: Same groups/weights, independent nonnegative intercept-only least squares fit: weighted mean residual. Do not reuse the intercept from the geometric fit.
threshold_rule: Weighted quantiles of UID out-of-fold calibration predictions only; include all ties. Refit once on512 calibration UIDs and freeze coefficients, OOF thresholds and group map before evaluating development. Report OOF-to-final threshold coverage shift without adjustment.
advance_rule: All: calibrated geometry minus intercept-only AUROC paired UID95 lower>0 at0.5; at OOF80% threshold development coverage>=70% and serious rate<=half overall; at OOF10/20/50% thresholds nonempty retained regions have serious rate<=overall. Budget differences are reported but cannot rescue failed reuse gates.
stop_rule: One grouping/fitting specification only. If gates fail stop this scale correction; no regrouping, threshold search, compression, tiered check or scheduler in this round.
cost: Reuse old scores/residuals with0 model forwards. Charge full accurate checks for all ranked states prospectively, plus2 arithmetic operations per affine score; intercept-only needs no geometry. Prior preparation/teacher access retained, not claimed free.
resource_basis: At most16 two-variable fits per fold plus final fit,15299 development rows and500 paired UID draws; previous2000 permutation+500 bootstrap audit took45.56s. CPU only.
